title: Vinyume vya Vitenzi (Theme 9: Magonjwa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the verb of the opposite action, by -ua where it applies (funga/fungua) or by another verb (ingia/toka).
steps: Check it is not just a negative.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "fungua" and two more pairs, one without -ua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "kufunga" ni ___." Kwa nini "kutofunga" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha kitenzi ni kitenzi kingine chenye maana ya kutengua kitendo, kama kufunga - kufungua. Si "kutofunga".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "kuvaa" ni ___." Kwa nini "kuvaua" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vitenzi vingine vinabadilika kwa njia tofauti. Kinyume cha kuvaa ni kuvua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "kuingia" ni ___." Kwa nini "kuingilia" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume kina maana ya upande wa pili. Kuingia na kutoka ni vinyume.

misconceptions.ask: Kuna neno lingine lenye maana kinyume?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha panda (mlima) ni shuka; si kila kitenzi hutumia -ua.
